definitions: A coworker, usually of the opposite sex, with whom one shares a special relationship that is very close, but not romantic or sexual.
A colleague with whom one has a strong bond, often involving mutual support and understanding, similar to a marital relationship but strictly platonic.
examples: My work spouse always knows how I like my coffee.
He and his work spouse collaborate on every major project.
She confided in her work spouse about the office politics.
